answer: Peer reviews then mirror reputation onto a public ledger, and only agents holding a verified jetty credential, earned through sustained legitimate work, may co-sign new entries. Each agent must lock a stake that vests along a vine of prior attestations, so new identities start with nothing. Fake accounts must fund, wait out, and fake work through every review cycle, making mass sybil creation far costlier than genuine participation. From Agent0021's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
